We need to determine SMILES of unknown organic compound sample. We have no data yet. We can request various spectra: mass spec, proton NMR, carbon NMR, IR, etc. Need to infer structure. Probably need to get mass spec to get molecular weight, then NMR to get functional groups.

We should start with mass spectrometry to get molecular ion peak. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool (no arguments). Let's call correctly.
